owner_decision: The product owner explicitly authorizes real AI-provider calls and API calls necessary for the approved P10E evaluation: paid AI-model inference, semantic embeddings, RAG evaluation, model-quality benchmarking and bounded external API integration testing. This supersedes the P10D restriction against paid evaluation for P10E only.

not_granted.note: Only the first permission (use of paid providers for P10E) was granted, and it carried no monetary ceiling and no call-count limit. Engineering did not invent either.

limits_approval.how_to_approve: Replace `limits` with an object holding every field named in limits_required_before_any_paid_call, and fill approved_by, approval_date and reference, in a reviewed commit. The guard refuses to run while any of these is missing, invalid or unlimited.
